# Current environment matrix

This file captures the current local development defaults for this workspace.
Update it when the shared local-machine baseline changes, and keep personal secrets or machine-specific credentials out of it.

| Category | Current default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Operating system | Windows 11 | Current local default for repo work |
| Editor | VS Code Insiders | Primary editor used for the multi-root workspace |
| Workspace shape | Multi-root workspace | Open via `LMS.code-workspace` with `LMS` and `appoint-skills` |
| Terminal | PowerShell (`pwsh`) | Preferred local shell for commands and validation |
| AI tooling | GitHub Copilot + Copilot Chat | Primary AI assistant surface in VS Code |
| Linked workspace note | `LMS, appoint-planning-system` may be present as a sibling repos | Shared workspace context can include the LMS monorepo, but this repo is separate from it |
| Repo role | Appoint control-plane repo | Holds Appoint agents, skills, plugin scaffolds, and supporting documentation |
